courts.rules: Court 1 Make sure you select the correct reservation date - the default is always the next day! Courts are $10/hour on weekdays until 4:00pm. 4:00pm until closing plus weekends and City holidays are $14/hour. Reserve tennis court for maximum of two hours, one court per household.Rules:*No teaching of any kind is permissible except by authorized concessionaires.*No equipment other than tennis rackets and balls are allowed on the court except by authorized concessionaires.*A maximum of six balls shall be used on any one court except by authorized concessionaires.Reservations opens eight days in advance at 8am.NO REFUNDS GIVEN
